id: 18_Basic Electrical Engineering Laboratory Viva Questions on Two-Way and Three-Way
title: 双控与三控照明：口试问答与家庭用电
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/18_Basic Electrical Engineering Laboratory Viva Questions on Two-Way and Three-Way.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/18_Basic Electrical Engineering Laboratory Viva Questions on Two-Way and Three-Way/src.py

points.K5: 三控电路：加一个中间开关
points.K10: 家用电器为什么要并联

shots.scene: 欣欣站在楼梯口，楼梯上下各有一个开关，头顶一盏灯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the foot of a staircase with a wall switch at the bottom and another at the top, one ceiling lamp above, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 大家好！今天复习双控和三控照明。
overlay: 双控与三控照明：口试问答与家庭用电

shots.scene: 楼梯、走廊、家里插座三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a staircase with a lamp, a long corridor with a lamp, and a wall socket. No people.
shots.narration: 还有家里的电器为什么要并联。

shots.scene: 阿杰在宿舍楼梯下按开关，灯亮了；他走到楼上犯愁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches on a stair light at the bottom of the dormitory stairs, then stands at the top looking puzzled.
shots.narration: 阿杰上了楼，楼下的灯怎么关？

shots.scene: 小研在楼上按另一个开关，灯灭了，阿杰惊讶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses the second switch at the top of the stairs and the lamp turns off; the young male student looks surprised.
shots.narration: 小研一按楼上的开关，灯就灭了。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着两个开关之间的连线图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at an icon of two switches linked by two wires to one lamp.
shots.narration: 这就是双控，口试常考！

shots.scene: 楼梯上下两个开关控制一盏灯的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a staircase with a switch at the bottom and a switch at the top, both controlling one lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：双控用在哪？楼梯最典型。

shots.scene: 卧室门口和床头各一个开关，控制吊灯
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bedroom with one switch by the door and one by the bed, both controlling the ceiling lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 卧室门口和床头也常这样装。

shots.scene: 两个相隔较远的开关和一盏灯
shots.prompt_en: Two switches placed far apart, connected to a single lamp in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 两个不同位置的开关，控制同一盏灯。

shots.scene: 单相交流电源、一盏灯、两个开关组成的电路图标
shots.prompt_en: A circuit icon: a single-phase AC source, one lamp, and two switches S1 and S2. No people.
shots.narration: 单相交流电源、一盏六十瓦灯、两个开关。

shots.scene: 两个开关之间两根联络线高亮
shots.prompt_en: The two connecting wires between the two switches highlighted in the circuit icon. No people.
shots.narration: 两个开关之间，用两根联络线相连。

shots.scene: 一个开关有两个触点位置的放大图标
shots.prompt_en: A close-up icon of a switch with one common terminal and two contact positions. No people.
shots.narration: 每个开关有两个位置，可以来回切换。

shots.scene: 空白表格，四行只有亮灯和灭灯图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank four-row table grid with only lamp-on and lamp-off icons in its last column. No people.
shots.narration: 双控真值表一共四种组合。

shots.scene: 两个开关拨到同一侧，灯亮
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two switches set to matching positions and the lamp glowing. No people.
shots.narration: A 对 C、B 对 D，电路接通灯亮。

shots.scene: 两个开关拨到不同侧，灯灭
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two switches set to opposite positions and the lamp dark. No people.
shots.narration: A 对 D、B 对 C，电路断开灯灭。

shots.scene: 欣欣拨动任意一个开关，灯状态翻转
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot flips one of two switches and the lamp changes state.
shots.narration: 规律：拨动任何一个，灯就翻转。

shots.scene: 一条长走廊，两端和中间各一个开关，一盏灯
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a long corridor with switches at both ends and one in the middle, controlling one lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：三控用在哪？长走廊。

shots.scene: 走廊两侧是一排排带栏杆的门，三个开关分布在走廊上
shots.prompt_en: A long corridor lined with many barred cell doors, three wall switches spaced along it. No people.
shots.narration: 比如监狱牢房外的走廊，叫监狱布线。

shots.scene: 三个开关分布在走廊上，控制同一盏灯
shots.prompt_en: Three wall switches spaced along a corridor, all controlling the same lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 三个位置，开关同一盏灯。

shots.section_title: 三控电路：加一个中间开关
shots.scene: 三控电路图标：两端两个开关，中间多一个开关
shots.prompt_en: A circuit icon: one lamp with a switch at each end and an extra switch in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 三控电路：两端还是双控开关。
overlay: 三控电路：加一个中间开关

shots.section_title: 三控电路：加一个中间开关
shots.scene: 中间开关高亮，四个接线端
shots.prompt_en: The middle switch highlighted, showing four terminals. No people.
shots.narration: 中间再加一个中间开关。

shots.scene: 中间开关内部两条线平行连接
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the intermediate switch with two internal links running straight across, parallel. No people.
shots.narration: 中间开关有两种状态。第一种：直通。

shots.scene: 中间开关内部两条线交叉连接
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the intermediate switch with two internal links crossing each other in an X shape. No people.
shots.narration: 第二种：交叉。

shots.scene: 欣欣双手先平行后交叉比划
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds two arms parallel, then crosses them in an X.
shots.narration: 一按开关，就在直通和交叉之间切换。

shots.scene: 八行空白表格，只有亮灭图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank eight-row table grid with only lamp-on and lamp-off icons in the last column. No people.
shots.narration: 三控真值表一共八行。

shots.scene: 表格前四行被圈出，标平行线图标
shots.prompt_en: The top four rows of the table circled, marked with a parallel-lines icon. No people.
shots.narration: 前四行是直通，亮、灭、灭、亮。

shots.scene: 表格后四行被圈出，标交叉图标
shots.prompt_en: The bottom four rows of the table circled, marked with a crossing X icon. No people.
shots.narration: 后四行是交叉，灭、亮、亮、灭。

shots.scene: 三个开关任拨一个，灯状态翻转
shots.prompt_en: An icon of three switches; flipping any one of them changes the lamp state. No people.
shots.narration: 同样，拨动任何一个开关，灯就翻转。

shots.scene: 一个开关符号：一个触点、一个闸刀
shots.prompt_en: A switch symbol icon with one blade and a single contact. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：什么是单刀单掷开关？

shots.scene: 闸刀合上灯亮，打开灯灭
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the single blade closing to light a lamp and opening to turn it off. No people.
shots.narration: 一个刀、一个位置，只管通和断。

shots.scene: 阿杰把画好的空白真值表交给王老师
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands a drawn table sheet with only lamp icons to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 第四题：画真值表。做实验前就要交。

shots.scene: 王老师检查后点头，阿杰才开始接线
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the sheet and nods; only then does the young male student start wiring on the bench.
shots.narration: 老师查过、允许了，才开始做。

shots.section_title: 家用电器为什么要并联
shots.scene: 一排家用电器并排接在两根电源线上
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a TV, a lamp and a fan each connected side by side across two supply lines. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：家里的电器怎么接？并联。
overlay: 家用电器为什么要并联

shots.section_title: 家用电器为什么要并联
shots.scene: 每个插座旁都标着相同的电压图标
shots.prompt_en: Several wall socket icons, each with an identical small voltage badge. No people.
shots.narration: 并联时，每个插座都是二百三十伏。

shots.section_title: 家用电器为什么要并联
shots.scene: 关掉电视，台灯和风扇照常工作
shots.prompt_en: An icon row where the TV is switched off but the lamp and the fan keep working. No people.
shots.narration: 关掉一个电器，别的照常用。

shots.section_title: 家用电器为什么要并联
shots.scene: 三个电器串成一串的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of three appliances connected in a single chain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 要是串联，电压被分掉，一断全断。

shots.section_title: 家用电器为什么要并联
shots.scene: 欣欣举着并联图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with a parallel-circuit icon.
shots.narration: 所以家庭布线一定是并联。

shots.scene: 平行和交叉两个图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: two parallel lines and two crossing lines. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：直通和交叉怎么分？

shots.scene: 直通图标标 EF、GH，交叉图标标 EH、FG
shots.prompt_en: The parallel-lines icon and the crossing icon, each with small terminal letters. No people.
shots.narration: E 连 F、G 连 H 是直通，反之交叉。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白笔记本上画开关图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student draws switch icons in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 要点记下来，有疑问就问老师。

shots.scene: 楼梯双控和走廊三控两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a staircase with two-way switches and a corridor with three switches. No people.
shots.narration: 双控楼梯，三控长走廊。

shots.scene: 直通和交叉、八行表格图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of parallel and crossing links next to an eight-row table with lamp icons. No people.
shots.narration: 中间开关分直通和交叉，真值表要会画。

shots.scene: 并联电器和单刀开关图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of parallel-connected appliances and a single-blade switch. No people.
shots.narration: 家用电器并联；单刀单掷只管通断。

shots.scene: 欣欣在楼梯口按下开关，灯亮，挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot presses the stair switch, the lamp lights up, and it waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 祝口试顺利，下次见！
